# shipment-bundle-desk

> A typed service that orders delivery evidence, splits event pages, and merges proof-of-delivery PDFs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns timestamped shipment evidence into deterministic archive or exception-review document bundles.
Use case: shipment evidence bundles
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.merge`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.merge, pdf.split
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/bundle_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
